name: How to Benchmark LLMs
title: How to Benchmark LLMs
summary: Choose models using evidence from your application’s inputs and output formats. Run identical tasks through OpenRouter and compare graded accuracy, billed cost, and request time. On our 60 synthetic tasks, GPT-6.1 Sol passed 180/180 trials across three repeats under the tested contracts and settings.
